content.text: LibreOffice has the file open. I'll close it first, then modify the slide14.xml, repackage, and verify.

input.command: kill 2460 2444 2>/dev/null; sleep 3; ps aux | grep -i -E "soffice|libreoffice" | grep -v grep

cat > /tmp/modify_slide.py << 'PYEOF'
import re

with open('/tmp/pptx_extract/ppt/slides/slide14.xml', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find the first textbox sp containing "Target audience" - id=211, currently sz="7000"
# Find the second textbox sp containing "Elaborate on what" - id=212, currently sz="2200"

# Replace the first textbox font sizes (id 211 - "Target audience")
# It has sz="7000" twice (rPr and endParaRPr)
pattern1 = r'(<p:cNvPr id="211"[^>]*></p:cNvPr>.*?)sz="7000"(.*?)sz="7000"(.*?</p:sp>)'
def repl1(m):
    return m.group(1) + 'sz="6000"' + m.group(2) + 'sz="6000"' + m.group(3)
content = re.sub(pattern1, repl1, content, count=1, flags=re.DOTALL)

# Replace the second textbox font sizes (id 212 - "Elaborate...")
pattern2 = r'(<p:cNvPr id="212"[^>]*></p:cNvPr>.*?)sz="2200"(.*?)sz="2200"(.*?</p:sp>)'
def repl2(m):
    return m.group(1) + 'sz="2800"' + m.group(2) + 'sz="2800"' + m.group(3)
content = re.sub(pattern2, repl2, content, count=1, flags=re.DOTALL)

with open('/tmp/pptx_extract/ppt/slides/slide14.xml', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(content)

# Verify
